deals.title: Epic Day Pass
deals.blackout: Peak holiday dates not included unless you add Peak Dates (+$87 on a 4-day). 4- to 7-day passes also cover Telluride and the 6 Canadian Rockies partners.
deals.expiresNote: Prices go up after Nov 15. Sales usually end in early December.
notes: Pick 1–7 days now, choose when and where to ride later
Save 20% on lodging, rentals and dining with Epic Mountain Rewards
A cheaper 32-resort version is $375 for 4 days
Does not include Epic Friend Tickets

deals.title: Quad Pack+
deals.blackout: No blackout dates. Valid at Mammoth and June Mountain.
deals.expiresNote: Limited-time offer; end date not posted. Summer price was $100/day, now $125/day.
notes: Any 4 days, all season
30% off extra days once the 4 are used
Add a Rental Quad Pack at checkout for up to 50% off rentals
One person only; non-refundable

deals.title: 4-Day Lift Pack, Unrestricted
deals.expiresNote: Prices rise closer to the season; no fixed end date posted.
notes: Extra days at 50% off the window rate
Friends & Family tickets at 25% off the window rate
Also: 2-Day Unrestricted $369 · 4-Day Midweek $390 (no weekends, so not for Sat–Sun trips)

deals.title: 2-Day Lift Pack, Unrestricted
deals.expiresNote: Prices rise closer to the season; no fixed end date posted.
notes: Extra days at 50% off the window rate
Friends & Family tickets at 25% off the window rate

deals.title: Lift Ticket 3-PAK
deals.blackout: No blackout dates. Weekend parking reservation $25/day (free with 4+ in the car).
notes: Any 3 days of the season
Pairs well with free Powder Alliance Sundays: use the 3-PAK on Saturdays
2-of-3-day ticket also available at $145/day

deals.title: 2-Day and 4-Day Passes
deals.blackout: No blackout dates; valid every operating day of 26/27.
notes: One card, one person, use any days
Covered by your Cali Pass if you have one: this is for friends or a no-pass season

deals.title: Anytime 2-Pack and 4-Pack
deals.expiresNote: Unused days expire at the end of the 26/27 season. No sale end date posted.
notes: One card, one person (ages 13+)
Non-refundable

deals.title: Ikon Session Pass (2, 3 or 4 days)
deals.blackout: Blackouts Dec 26–30, Jan 16–17, Feb 13–14. Lift reservations required.
deals.expiresNote: Sales end in December; exact date not posted. Prices rise during the fall.
notes: Split days across Mammoth, June, Palisades, Sierra-at-Tahoe, Big Bear and 40+ others
Ikon Base Pass upgrade from $1,099

deals.title: Buy online in advance
deals.blackout: Limited number of low-price tickets each day. Holiday rates Dec 26–Jan 3, Jan 15–17, Feb 12–14.
deals.expiresNote: Ongoing; cheapest when bought days ahead.
notes: As low as $139 online ($129 early/late season) vs up to $179 at the window

deals.title: Cali Pass Buddy Tickets
deals.blackout: 50% off weekdays (non-holiday), 40% off weekends & holidays, off the full-price adult ticket.
deals.expiresNote: 10 per season, 1 per day; valid through the 26/27 season.
notes: Redeem at any of the 4 Cali Pass resorts
Example: a $159 Dodge Saturday is about $95 for your friend

deals.title: Epic Friend Tickets
deals.blackout: 50% off the window price for friends 13+, 25% off for kids. Not included with Epic Day Pass.
notes: Sent from your Epic account to any friend
Friend can apply the cost toward their own Epic Pass

deals.title: Ikon Friends & Family tickets
deals.blackout: Up to 25% off the window rate on days the holder's pass is valid.
notes: Ikon Pass, Base Pass and Palisades lift-pack holders can share them
